title: AI Opportunity: Developers Not Replaced by AI #shorts
description: We're told AI replaces 20 people, yet companies pour billions into specialized teams. The gap between 'easy AI' and 'AI needs an army' is the real opportunity. We help implement AI to augment, not replace, letting humans focus on what they do best. #AIImplementation #BusinessStrategy #StartupHack #FutureOfWork
